company.name: FORASNA
company.shortDescription: FORASNA's is the first and most reliable recruitment platform in the Middle East that targets job seekers from all educational background.
company.description: FORASNA is a database for the Middle Eastern workforce with primary/middle education (blue collars). It also caters to highly educated job seekers (white collars) looking for positions that do not require knowledge of any other language than Arabic. It has the first organized and systematic database and platform focused on connecting blue collars with employers: assisting job seekers in finding the right job and assisting companies in hiring suitable candidates in an easy and smart manner.

productsAndServices.description: An online job portal connecting job seekers from all educational backgrounds with employers across various industries in the Middle East.
